section_summary.extract_value: This section concludes that humor production is correlated with intelligence and creativity, extending previous findings by showing that humor production ability is independently predicted by measures of creativity and intelligence. Specifically, the funniness of humorous ideas relies on DT fluency, DT creativity, and crystallized intelligence, highlighting the role of different domain-general cognitive abilities for humor.
